public_edition.epistemic_status: Editorial derivative of the dated private research report. Scientific claims, original review outcomes and source hashes describe that historical review, not newly executed public-edition verification. No tests, builds, lint, firmware execution or vehicle observations were performed for this edition.
public_edition.interpretation_boundary: Original research equations, decoded addresses, scalar observations and engineering interpretations are retained as analysis, not redistributed firmware source or a flash-ready calibration. Static software dataflow is not physical hardware identity, runtime activation, measurement or safety approval.

private_source_availability.status: Original reports and referenced evidence remain outside this public edition. No download, access entitlement, redistribution permission or automatic access-on-request is represented.
private_source_availability.independent_review: Reproduction requires separately and lawfully obtained source material matching the retained hashes, relevant tools, and sufficient permissions. Hashes and private-source identifiers are provenance locators, not substitutes for the omitted evidence.
private_source_availability.reference_semantics: Source-evidence and provenance fields document what the original review used. Unless a public URL or a public research-summary path is explicitly given, they do not identify a file distributed here. See evidence/README.md.
